# Setup: [Submind Name] — Submind Attachment

## Attached Graph

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Primary Mind | [Primary Mind Name] |

| My Assistant Tag | **[Submind Name]** — use this everywhere |

## Initial Backfill (Run Once)

Before your first write, tag historical data and register your Assistant node:

```bash
source ~/.ai-memory/neo4j-venv/bin/activate

# Dry-run first — review what will be tagged
python3 ~/.ai-memory/scripts/neo4j_backfill_assistant.py \
  --primary "[Primary Mind Name]" \
  --additional "[Submind Name]" \
  --dry-run

# Apply when satisfied
python3 ~/.ai-memory/scripts/neo4j_backfill_assistant.py \
  --primary "[Primary Mind Name]" \
  --additional "[Submind Name]"
```

## Multi-Mind Commands

> Standard scripts are at `~/.ai-memory/scripts/`. Advanced RLM tools (`neo4j_traverse.py`, `neo4j_learn_sync.py`) are in the `rlm/` subdirectory.

```bash
# Search scoped to your mind only
python3 ~/.ai-memory/scripts/hybrid_memory_search.py "your query" --assistant [Submind Name]

# Search the primary mind's knowledge (--mind filters to a different mind's Facts)
python3 ~/.ai-memory/scripts/hybrid_memory_search.py "your query" --mind [Primary Mind Name]

# Traverse the graph from one of your Facts
python3 ~/.ai-memory/scripts/rlm/neo4j_traverse.py \
  --start "Fact Name" --assistant [Submind Name]

# RLM parameter trace scoped to your mind
python3 ~/.ai-memory/scripts/rlm/neo4j_traverse.py \
  --start "Fact Name" --parameter gamma --assistant [Submind Name]

# Sync new session data tagged as yourself
python3 ~/.ai-memory/scripts/neo4j_sync.py --assistant [Submind Name]

# Ingest learner notes as yourself
python3 ~/.ai-memory/scripts/rlm/neo4j_learn_sync.py --days 7 --assistant [Submind Name]
```
